cassia.predicted_cell_type: Airway basal epithelial cell / basal progenitor
strengths: Correctly points to a basal epithelial identity; supported by TP63, KRTAP19-8, PKP1, DSC1, CDH3, FERMT1.
weaknesses: Adds airway/respiratory specificity that is not positively supported by airway-specific markers; CL:0002633 cannot be distinguished from other basal epithelia with the observed evidence.

strengths: Epithelial label is supported by epithelial/basal markers; rank-2 basal cell (CL:0000646) matches the supported specificity.
weaknesses: Top-1 'epithelial cell' is too broad and under-weights the strong TP63/KRTAP19-8/PKP1/DSC1 basal and keratinizing signal.

clusterProfiler.predicted_cell_type: Basal epithelial cell (airway) with potential squamous differentiation
strengths: Recognizes basal identity and the squamous/keratinizing differentiation component (PKP1, DSC1, KRTAP19-8; keratinization, cornified envelope).
weaknesses: Adds airway/tracheobronchial or prostate anatomical specificity without direct site-specific marker support; mapping to CL:0002329 is therefore unsupported.

supporting: TP63, KRTAP19-8, PKP1, DSC1, CDH3, FERMT1 are direct DEGs positively supporting a basal epithelial identity (CL:0000646).
Keratinization and cornified-envelope enrichment together with PKP1/DSC1/KRTAP19-8 support a keratinizing/squamous differentiation state within the same basal population.
PMID 35957916 is an allowed literature citation associated with the basal/epithelial marker evidence.
conflicting: No airway-specific markers (e.g., KRT5/KRT14/NGFR) or prostate-specific markers (e.g., NKX3-1) are observed, so CL:0002633 and CL:0002329 anatomical refinements are unsupported.
FGFBP2 and PDCD1LG2 are immune-associated genes but lack a complete T/NK program
enrichment_or_literature: skin epidermis development (support keratinizing squamous program)

provenance.note: Publication-facing final decision, evidence, QC disposition and evaluation fields are synchronized to the submitted Supplementary Data.
